name: dev
description: Plan-driven software development with subagent delegation: explore, plan, execute, and review.

interface.shortDescription: Explore, plan, delegate, execute, and review software changes.
interface.longDescription: Dev packages four skills: the three plan-driven development skills plus a cross-cutting model-tiering framework. dev-explore maps the codebase and converges on a direction, dev-write-plan turns that direction into an outcome contract under wiki/plans/, and dev-execute-plan implements the plan — delegating implementation to a host subagent by default — before verifying the result. subagent-model injects the owner's model-tiering rule at session start (Claude Code only) and ships it as a consultable skill: mechanically verifiable work drops two or more tiers, self-contained work drops one, and trusted-conclusion work keeps the parent tier.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-explore to understand this codebase and converge on an approach.
Use dev-write-plan to turn this requirement into an implementation plan.
Use dev-execute-plan to implement a TODO plan and review the result.
